description: (Na)₂KGaF₆ crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a KGaF₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the KGaF₆ framework, K is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form KF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent GaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All K-F bond lengths are 2.46 Å. Ga is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form GaF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent KF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Ga-F bond lengths are 1.91 Å. F is bonded in a linear geometry to one K and one Ga atom.
